review.posthog_relevance: Adds keyboard shortcut configuration and Monaco editor exclusion to the Logs Viewer and editor context, allowing users to retain shortcuts while typing and opt-out when viewing logs.

review.uncertainty: The actual implementation of the key bindings and their effects is not shown; this chunk only establishes the configuration and DOM checks. The tier is established conservatively as a narrow, localized maintenance or behavior correction rather than a broader systemic improvement.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the keyboard shortcut behavior, only the configuration and the use of the useKeyboardHotkeys hook. The actual key bindings and their effects are not shown, so the tier cannot be established.

observations.behavior: Adds Monaco editor to the list of DOM elements where typing should not trigger hotkeys.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows keyboard shortcuts to work while typing in Monaco editor, while not capturing input events.

observations.behavior: Adds keyboardShortcutsEnabled prop to LogsViewer, allowing the viewer to opt-out of keyboard shortcuts.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the Logs viewer to disable keyboard shortcuts when not in viewer tab, potentially to avoid conflicts with other controls.
